review_text: CHIVV Flooring did an amazing job installing our hardwood floors for our 3 bedrooms and hallway! Very professional and completed the job in 1 day. I am so pleased with the workmanship and the quality of my new floors! They were so easy to work with and communicated with us throughout the entire process. I will definitely contact them again with any further flooring that we do!

These guys did a great job replacing all of our main floor carpet with AquaGuard Performance wood-based laminate.  They went above and beyond to fix a couple issue we discovered during installation!!!
Great price and great service. They were always in communication and were honest with their pricing and schedule. I will definitely use them again. I couldn't recommend them enough

We utilized Chivv Flooring to replace our engineered hardwood floors. We found them cost competitive and the quality of their work is outstanding. They completed the job quickly and efficiently and their attention to detail was exceptional. We highly recommend them.
Chivv Flooring amazing job, timely, polite, great workmanship just a pleasure to do business with

We are extremely happy with the work that Charles and his team did on our floors. He was thorough and professional and explained everything every step of the way. The finished product was even better than expected.  100% recommend Charles and the CHIVV team.  Well done guys.

Professional, knowledgeable, organized, efficient and quality are the words to describe the service that Charles and his team provided for our renovation project. Charles and his team installed the floors in our condo in two days compared to a previous contractor that wasn't able to install the floors in three weeks and were asking for an additional two weeks to install the floors. We were lucky to find Charles who really rescued our project with compassion and great communication.
If you are lucky to get Charles and his team for your project, look no further. This is coming from someone that had multiple contractors for different projects.
Highly recommended!

Installers did a fantastic job leveling our subfloor and installing new floors. Charles was very thorough and quickly came back to address my minor concerns. Seams are all flawless and they brought tarps to minimize dust. They were very careful when moving our furniture and worked quickly to get the job done. Transitions are all well done. Charles had great ideas for future improvements and I would definitely use Chivv Flooring again.
They did a GREAT job tearing out our old floors, installing new hardwoods and refinishing our stairs and railing!  Will use them again in the future.
Very professional and prompt. We had over 800 sq.ft. and completed the job in 2 days.
Excellent and efficient service!!!
We got so much information from our consultation with CHIVV Consulting! I highly recommend their services.

After multiple quotes and different opinions I decided to go with CHIVV. They did an outstanding job replacing my subfloor and installing the new flooring. They were the most expensive but after the excellent work, clean up, and attention to detail I am extremely happy with the service.

I had hardwood flooring Installed in 2 bedrooms and tile in a bathroom. They did the job quickly and it looks very professional. Also, they did a good job of cleaning up after the work was complete. Very happy with how the project went. I will use them again on future projects.
Impressed with the quality of the work.  I recommend this company to anyone.

Chivv-flooring is an outstanding company. I would highly recommend them for business. They installed hardwood steps in our home. They were able to match the colors of the floors and the landing at the front door. The job was done in a timely manner and with high quality materials. The workers were very respectful, efficient and prompt . My wife and I were very pleased.

I appreciated that Charles provided me with suggestions and demonstrated his expertise in flooring installation. He and his crew arrived as scheduled. His price was very reasonable. I selected him because of all the great reviews. Which I can attest to now as well. I would highly recommend him.

Charles was my point of contact. He came out and measured my basement. He also was the one who installed my flooring.  He was very professional, all my questions was answered. Charles made everything clear to me. Charles and his crew did an OUTSTANDING JOB.
Very knowledgeable and professional. Very happy with end result. Would definitely use them again.

Charles did all of the hardwood floors in my house and to say we are happy with the results is an understatement. He is very professional and knowledgeable, and his prices are very reasonable. His customer service just makes the whole experience all the better. I refer all of my friends to him and anyone else looking to have floors installed. You won't be disappointed

Charles and his team did a fantastic job installing flooring in my new home three weeks ago. I just purchased a new home and wanted to replace the carpet in my entire basement, including the stairs, as well as a couple of other rooms. The quote Charles provided was better than others and Chivv actually used better materials. The Chivv team was on-time, professional, and very easy to work with.  Additionally, Charles is adamant about using quality materials.  My wife and I are extremely happy with the results.  My realtor recommended Chivv to me and I am happy he did.
Charles was so professional and very easy to work with. Him and his crew did a wonderful job and answered every question I had. I would highly recommend them to install your new floors!

We absolutely recommend Charles Silva and his crew!! They did an amazing job on our flooring install! We had squeaky floors and large spot of adhesives from previous flooring that they took care of and you would never know any of it was there! The floors no longer squeak which is so nice! We are so in love with our new floors!

Charles was incredibly professional, has great prices, and an amazing work ethic! We will definitely be having these guys back out for future flooring projects as we move to other area of our home! THANK YOU CHARLES!!!

CHIVV Flooring is just about the most knowledgeable, professional and honest team of guys you'll find out there, end of story. Don't look elsewhere.

They recently installed Engineered Wood Flooring, and tile in the main areas of my house and SPC flooring in my basement. Along the way a few issues came up. They discovered, old linoleum and old engineered wood flooring under the floating floors they were removing, the subfloor was not even once those hidden floors were removed.

Most companies would've used that stressful situation to charge you a lot of extra money for the inconvenience.

Not Charles and his team, they gave us options and help us get to very affordable solution to help us finish the project and to address the unforeseen event.

He also went out of his way to help me solve a different problem in the house not related to flooring.

It goes without saying, we are very pleased with professionalism and pride they take on the work they do. I recommend them 100%.

We live in Illinois are moving to Georgia this summer. We replaced the old carpeting with laminate flooring. Well I ordered the wrong product, thank heaven Charles texted me with a picture and asked if this was what I wanted. It was not! He worked with us to get the perfect  match for our floors.
He sent videos of his work everyday and kept in constant contact. We are so pleased! Highly recommend his work!
They were very professional and courteous. I  highly recommend them for flooring installation.

I had a great experience working with Charles. He was knowledgeable and went above and beyond helping me get the most value for my money.  I learned a lot in the process and never felt rushed or pressured. We are so happy with the end result and would highly recommend.
Charles was very knowledgeable about the flooring products and did a great job for us. I highly recommend his services!!

We are extremely happy with the service we received from Chiiv flooring. They replaced our hardwood floors and it looks amazing. The work was completed in one day. I would recommend to anyone. They were very nice and professional
The gentlemen arrived on time and were very professional. They did an amazing job on our floors. I highly recommend them.

I hired CHIVV one Year ago That WONDERFUL WORK, they are very responsible, my wooden floor is perfect I will do more renovate in my house and I will call them again.  I totally recommend if you need complete professionals.
